title: Newmark Arranges Sale and Financing of 229-Unit Hathaway at Willow Bend Community in Plano, Texas
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale and financing of Hathaway at Willow Bend, a 229-unit multifamily community located at 2525 Preston Road in Plano, Texas.
